name: PostgreSQL
tagline: Everything a PostgreSQL database needs before your app connects — down to privileges, migrations and publications.
highlights: single static binary in a scratch image

features.title: Idempotent
features.body: Run it on every deploy. Existing resources are reconciled, not recreated.

features.title: Additive and safe
features.body: Never drops roles, databases, schemas, tables or grants that aren't in the config. Privileges are removed only through explicit revokes.

features.title: Secret-friendly
features.body: ${VAR} references and *_FILE secrets (Docker, Kubernetes); passwords are redacted from every log line.

features.title: Previewable
features.body: --dry-run logs every statement it would execute.

features.title: Small
features.body: A single static binary in a scratch image.
